text:
A great service. A friend and I went for a walk-in appointment for a clean and polish. We were seen to straight away. Paid 1200 baht each. I would recommend this to anyone thinking of seeing a hygienist in Thailand.

The staff were very friendly and helpful with advice on keeping my teeth in good health.

All round great experience.
Wonderful experience here !  Easy check in and taken care of the same day. Returned to get additional work done and couldn't be happier.  Big thanks to everyone who works there!!

Professional, polite, knowledgeable, thoughtful, HONEST, excellent work.
Dr and staff are excellent. Prices are reasonable and not inflated.

I will definitely return when I am in Bangkok

We had a great experience at this dental clinic! My dad needed a dental filling, and although we didn't have an appointment, the staff was very accommodating. The lady at the front desk was friendly and welcoming, and the dentist was professional and efficient. Overall, the service was excellent, and we're very happy with the results. Highly recommended!

Just got a cleaning and a polish, ฿1000.  Very gentle, and thorough. Would definitely go back. They are equally as good as any American dentist, they’re probably better than American dentist to be honest.  Below is their price list, great value!

If you are traveling and need dental care I absolutely recommend this clinic!
A few days before leaving for Thailand, my wisdom tooth grew. I was very worried but luckily I found this place. The staff at the reception and the doctors are very kind people, helpful, smiling and who reassure you so much. I felt really serene, the operation didn't last long and everything went very well! They also gave me medicine to bring with me in case of pain. The place is clean, professional but also cozy. The prices are not high and honest. Thanks again to all the staff of Shining Smile Clinic, my journey can continue in the best way thanks to you! You were special🧡

Very high quality, professional, and inexpensive! I definitely recommend this clinic. I was extremely pleased, everything was done like at home. Many thanks to all the staff of this clinic, I wish you success and prosperity! This is the best clinic in Thailand in my rating!

Had such a lovely experience here! I had Orthodontic Treatment to fix my upper back fixed retainer that broke while I was here in Bangkok. They seen me almost straight away no appointment needed, the staff are so welcoming and done the job within a few minutes. Only cost me 800 bhat. Delighted with the service, thank you Shining Smile Dental Clinic 🤗

Such a fantastic dentist.
Really good care very good prices.
I had a clean and my partner had two fillings.
We are both very happy with the treatment.
Highly recommend
I was traveling and make the most of my stop in Bangkok to visit this clinic... they are 100% professional.

I am traveling thru Bangkok and have been travelling for 2 years getting dental work done in UK, Portugal & Malaysia.

This here has been world class with a complex filling done with anaesthetic for what was fair local price.

Dentists were exact and spoke enough English to make the process understandable.

Also very friendly from reception to chair 😊

No hesitation to recommend 👍👍👍

Super service !!! Amazing staff and skillful dentist.i can’t recommend them enough

Dr.Ming x
I got a quick and well done dental cleaning here. The staff was very friendly and it was a very easy to do even just walking in.
Filling and teeth cleaning done. Good price and very happy with results!
Dentist is very good and friendly. 100% satisfaction

The clinic is clean and beautiful. The staff and doctor are welcoming and very helpful in answering questions. The prices are fair.
Guaranteed to be a great experience. I loved it!

The doctor is kind, attentive, straightforward, transparent, and doesn't hide anything or prolong treatment unnecessarily. They have extensive experience, passed down through generations, guaranteeing skill and quality exceeding 5 stars.

She's an excellent dentist. She treated my 11-year-old son with great care and was very patient in explaining everything she did. Her prices are very reasonable, and she does her work carefully and without rushing. I highly recommend her.
See you on the same day!! Wow!! The people are super nice. I highly recommend it, especially since it's really cheap.
The clinic is small and clean. There is no clinic smell at all. The staff provides good service.
The doctor is a wonderful person, very communicative. He provided excellent treatment. Thank you so much.
Great service. I paid 1000 baht for a cleaning. I would do it again.
The doctor and assistants were very nice and provided excellent service. They always apologized and thanked me. It was very good and I was very impressed.
The doctor gave excellent advice. The tooth extraction was painless.
